; noteLinks - v2
; Obsidian-style links and region tags for notebooks.
;   Lasso handwriting -> tap "Link" or "Tag" chip (beside the lasso menu, finger tap)
;   Link: pick a notebook, then a page. A badge marks the spot; tap it to jump, "Back" pill returns.
;   Tag: pick or type a tag (handwriting is recognized and suggested when signed in).
;        Adds a normal page tag, plus a marker on the exact spot.
;   Toolbar link button: Links panel (from this page / linked from / tags index).
;   Long-press a badge or marker to remove it.
;   Home menu (hamburger) > "Links graph": every linked notebook and tag as a graph.
; Data: <doc>/notelinks.rm (JSON in a .rm wrapper, syncs with the notebook)
;       /home/root/.local/share/notelinks/index.json (local index for backlinks and tags)
; Target firmware: 3.29.1.0 (hashtab 3.29.1.0)
; Coexists with betterToc (uses its _isExtensionButton toolbar convention).
; Remove: delete noteLinks.qmd from /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/ and run /home/root/xovi/start.

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Silence the native "convert selection" handlers while noteLinks runs a
; recognition job, so the recognized text is not pasted into the page.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT [[15977735761668523171]]
    TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool nlSilent: false

            function nlStart(items) {
                if (!Authentication.loggedIn) {
                    return false;
                }
                root.nlSilent = true;
                Recognizer.startSelectionToolJob(items, Settings.handwritingConversionLanguage);
                return true;
            }

            function nlJobState() {
                const job = Recognizer.selectionToolJob;
                if (!job) {
                    return "none";
                }
                if (job.status === RecognitionJob.Status.Done) {
                    return "done";
                }
                if (job.status === RecognitionJob.Status.Error) {
                    return "error";
                }
                return "busy";
            }

            function nlJobText() {
                return Recognizer.selectionToolJob.formattedTextToClipboardText();
            }
        }
        TRAVERSE [[3914154588109996071]]#[[742117811095419965]]
            REPLACE [[12940955005542131354]] WITH {
                onFinishedChanged: {
                    if (root.nlSilent) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!finished) {
                        return;
                    }
                    Clipboard.text = recognitionJob.formattedTextToClipboardText();
                    if (Clipboard.hasText) {
                        conversionFinished();
                    }
                }
            }
            REPLACE [[13557874878952466453]] WITH {
                onFailedChanged: {
                    if (root.nlSilent) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (failed) {
                        conversionFailed();
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Toolbar: Links panel button (counted as an extension button like betterToc's)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Document view: data layer, lasso chips, badges, picker, tag dialog, panel
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // ================= noteLinks: state =================
            readonly property string nlRoot: "file:///home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl/"
            readonly property string nlIndexUrl: "file:///home/root/.local/share/notelinks/index.json"
            readonly property string nlRmHeader: "reMarkable .lines file, version=6          "
            readonly property string nlDocId: document ? String(document.id) : ""
            property var nlData: null
            property var nlIndex: null
            property int nlRev: 0
            property var nlSelRect: null
            property var nlCapture: null
            property var nlPending: null
            property var nlBack: null
            property bool nlBackShown: false
            property string nlToast: ""
            property bool nlPanelOpen: false
            property string nlPanelTab: "links"
            property bool nlPickerOpen: false
            property string nlPickerStage: "doc"
            property string nlPickerDoc: ""
            property string nlPickerDocName: ""
            property var nlPickerPages: []
            property string nlPickerNote: ""
            property int nlPickerLast: -1
            property var nlPickerEntry: null
            property bool nlThumbsOff: false
            property var nlPickerDocs: []
            property bool nlTagOpen: false
            property string nlTagSuggestion: ""
            property bool nlTagTyped: false
            property var nlTagChoices: []
            property var nlMenuItem: null
            property var nlHwcCb: null
            property int nlHwcTicks: 0
            property int nlPendingTicks: 0
            property var nlLib: null
            property string nlOpenTag: ""

            onNlDocIdChanged: {
                root.nlPanelOpen = false;
                root.nlPickerOpen = false;
                root.nlTagOpen = false;
                root.nlMenuItem = null;
                root.nlSelRect = null;
                root.nlLoad();
                if (root.nlPending && root.nlPending.docId === root.nlDocId) {
                    root.nlPendingTicks = 0;
                    nlPendingTimer.restart();
                }
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: storage =================
            function nlUtf8(s) {
                const out = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
                    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
                    if (c < 0x80) {
                        out.push(c);
                    } else if (c < 0x800) {
                        out.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 0x3f));
                    } else if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
                        c = 0x10000 + ((c & 0x3ff) << 10) + (s.charCodeAt(++i) & 0x3ff);
                        out.push(0xf0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 0x3f), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f), 0x80 | (c & 0x3f));
                    } else {
                        out.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f), 0x80 | (c & 0x3f));
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }

            function nlRmBytes(payload) {
                let utf = nlUtf8(payload);
                // the reader looks for the first open brace, so the length byte must not be one
                if ((utf.length & 0xff) === 0x7b) {
                    payload += " ";
                    utf = nlUtf8(payload);
                }
                const n = utf.length;
                const bytes = new Uint8Array(51 + n);
                for (let h = 0; h < 43; h++) bytes[h] = nlRmHeader.charCodeAt(h) & 0xff;
                bytes[43] = n & 0xff;
                bytes[44] = (n >>> 8) & 0xff;
                bytes[45] = (n >>> 16) & 0xff;
                bytes[46] = (n >>> 24) & 0xff;
                for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) bytes[51 + i] = utf[i];
                return bytes.buffer;
            }

            function nlGet(url, cb) {
                try {
                    const req = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    req.open("GET", url);
                    req.onreadystatechange = () => {
                        if (req.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                            cb(req.responseText || "");
                        }
                    };
                    req.send();
                } catch (e) {
                    cb("");
                }
            }

            function nlPut(url, body) {
                try {
                    const req = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    req.open("PUT", url);
                    req.send(body);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log("noteLinks: write failed " + url + " " + e);
                }
            }

            function nlParseJson(text) {
                const start = text.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(123));
                if (start < 0) return null;
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(text.substring(start));
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            function nlEmpty() {
                return { v: 1, links: [], tags: [] };
            }

            function nlLoadIndex(cb) {
                if (root.nlIndex) {
                    cb();
                    return;
                }
                nlGet(nlIndexUrl, (text) => {
                    const idx = nlParseJson(text);
                    root.nlIndex = (idx && idx.docs) ? idx : { v: 1, docs: {} };
                    cb();
                });
            }

            function nlLoad() {
                const docId = root.nlDocId;
                root.nlData = null;
                root.nlRev++;
                if (docId === "") return;
                nlLoadIndex(() => {
                    nlGet(nlRoot + docId + "/notelinks.rm", (text) => {
                        if (docId !== root.nlDocId) return;
                        let d = nlParseJson(text);
                        if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.links)) {
                            const cached = root.nlIndex.docs[docId];
                            d = cached ? { v: 1, links: cached.links || [], tags: cached.tags || [] } : nlEmpty();
                        }
                        if (!Array.isArray(d.tags)) d.tags = [];
                        root.nlData = d;
                        root.nlRev++;
                        nlSyncIndex(false);
                    });
                });
            }

            function nlPageNo(pageId) {
                try {
                    const p = document.pageForId(pageId);
                    return (typeof p === "number" && p >= 0) ? p + 1 : 0;
                } catch (e) {
                    return 0;
                }
            }

            function nlSyncIndex(force) {
                if (!root.nlIndex || !root.nlData || root.nlDocId === "") return;
                const d = root.nlData;
                for (const l of d.links) l.pageNo = nlPageNo(l.pageId) || l.pageNo || 0;
                for (const t of d.tags) t.pageNo = nlPageNo(t.pageId) || t.pageNo || 0;
                const entry = {
                    name: document ? document.visibleName : "",
                    links: d.links,
                    tags: d.tags
                };
                const before = JSON.stringify(root.nlIndex.docs[root.nlDocId] || null);
                const empty = d.links.length === 0 && d.tags.length === 0;
                if (empty) {
                    delete root.nlIndex.docs[root.nlDocId];
                } else {
                    root.nlIndex.docs[root.nlDocId] = entry;
                }
                const after = JSON.stringify(root.nlIndex.docs[root.nlDocId] || null);
                if (force || before !== after) {
                    nlPut(nlIndexUrl, JSON.stringify(root.nlIndex));
                }
            }

            function nlSave() {
                if (!root.nlData || root.nlDocId === "") return;
                nlPut(nlRoot + root.nlDocId + "/notelinks.rm", nlRmBytes(JSON.stringify(root.nlData)));
                nlSyncIndex(true);
                root.nlRev++;
            }

            function nlNewId() {
                return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7);
            }

            function nlShowToast(msg) {
                root.nlToast = msg;
                nlToastTimer.restart();
            }

            function nlDocName(docId, fallback) {
                const e = Library.entryForId(docId);
                return e ? e.visibleName : (fallback || "Missing notebook");
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: geometry =================
            function nlToView(r) {
                const tm = sceneView.tileManager;
                if (!r || !tm) return Qt.rect(-1000, -1000, 0, 0);
                return tm.sceneToView(Qt.rect(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3]));
            }

            property var nlPageItems: {
                root.nlRev;
                const pid = root.currentPageId;
                const out = [];
                if (!root.nlData || !pid) return out;
                for (const l of root.nlData.links) if (l.pageId === pid) out.push({ kind: "link", item: l });
                for (const t of root.nlData.tags) if (t.pageId === pid) out.push({ kind: "tag", item: t });
                return out;
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: lasso capture =================
            Connections {
                target: sceneView.controller
                ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                function onAreaSelected(layer, sceneRect) {
                    if (sceneRect.width > 0 && sceneRect.height > 0) {
                        root.nlSelRect = [sceneRect.x, sceneRect.y, sceneRect.width, sceneRect.height];
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: sceneView
                function onItemSelectionModeChanged() {
                    if (!sceneView.itemSelectionMode) root.nlSelRect = null;
                }
            }

            function nlTakeSelection() {
                if (!root.nlSelRect || !document) return null;
                let items = null;
                try {
                    items = sceneView.controller.cloneSelectedItems(sceneView.controller.currentLayer, sceneView.defaultScale);
                } catch (e) {
                    items = null;
                }
                const cap = {
                    pageId: String(root.currentPageId),
                    page: root.currentPage,
                    rect: root.nlSelRect.slice(0),
                    items: items
                };
                root.nlSelRect = null;
                try {
                    sceneView.endItemSelection();
                    sceneView.controller.clearSelectedItems();
                } catch (e) {
                }
                return cap;
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: handwriting recognition =================
            function nlCanRecognize() {
                try {
                    const tool = sceneView.hwcSelectionTool;
                    if (!tool || typeof tool.nlStart !== "function") return false;
                    if (tool.visible || tool.processing) return false;
                    return Boolean(Authentication.loggedIn);
                } catch (e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            function nlRecognize(items, cb) {
                if (!items || !nlCanRecognize()) {
                    cb("");
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    root.nlHwcCb = cb;
                    root.nlHwcTicks = 0;
                    if (sceneView.hwcSelectionTool.nlStart(items)) {
                        nlHwcTimer.restart();
                    } else {
                        nlHwcEnd("");
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    nlHwcEnd("");
                }
            }

            function nlHwcPoll() {
                root.nlHwcTicks++;
                let state = "error";
                try {
                    state = sceneView.hwcSelectionTool.nlJobState();
                } catch (e) {
                    state = "error";
                }
                if (state === "done") {
                    let t = "";
                    try {
                        t = sceneView.hwcSelectionTool.nlJobText();
                    } catch (e) {
                        t = "";
                    }
                    nlHwcEnd(t);
                } else if (state === "error" || root.nlHwcTicks > 60) {
                    nlHwcEnd("");
                }
            }

            function nlHwcEnd(t) {
                nlHwcTimer.stop();
                nlSilentReset.restart();
                const cb = root.nlHwcCb;
                root.nlHwcCb = null;
                if (cb) cb(String(t || "").replace(new RegExp("\\s+", "g"), " ").trim());
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlHwcTimer
                interval: 400
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: root.nlHwcPoll()
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlSilentReset
                interval: 2500
                onTriggered: {
                    if (sceneView.hwcSelectionTool && sceneView.hwcSelectionTool.nlSilent !== undefined) {
                        sceneView.hwcSelectionTool.nlSilent = false;
                    }
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlToastTimer
                interval: 3500
                onTriggered: root.nlToast = ""
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: links =================
            function nlBeginLink() {
                const cap = nlTakeSelection();
                if (!cap) return;
                const link = {
                    id: nlNewId(),
                    pageId: cap.pageId,
                    pageNo: cap.page + 1,
                    rect: cap.rect,
                    targetDoc: "",
                    targetPage: "",
                    targetPageNo: 0,
                    targetName: "",
                    label: ""
                };
                root.nlCapture = link;
                nlRecognize(cap.items, (text) => {
                    if (text === "") return;
                    link.label = text.length > 60 ? text.substring(0, 57) + "..." : text;
                    if (link.targetDoc !== "") nlSave();
                });
                nlOpenPicker();
            }

            function nlOpenPicker() {
                root.nlPickerStage = "doc";
                root.nlPickerDoc = "";
                root.nlPickerPages = [];
                nlPickerInput.text = "";
                nlRefreshDocs("");
                root.nlPickerOpen = true;
            }

            function nlEnsureLib() {
                if (root.nlLib) return root.nlLib;
                try {
                    root.nlLib = Qt.createQmlObject(
                        "import QtQuick; import com.remarkable; import xofm.libs.library; import xofm.bindings.qt; " +
                        "LibrarySearch { filter: LibraryView.Documents; sortOrder: LibraryView.RecentlyOpenedDate; " +
                        "library: Library; showRecentsIfTermEmpty: true; maximumResults: 40 }",
                        root, "noteLinksLibrarySearch");
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log("noteLinks: LibrarySearch unavailable " + e);
                    root.nlLib = null;
                }
                return root.nlLib;
            }

            function nlRefreshDocs(term) {
                const lib = nlEnsureLib();
                if (lib) {
                    try {
                        lib.searchTerm = term;
                    } catch (e) {
                    }
                    try {
                        lib.updateNow();
                    } catch (e) {
                    }
                }
                nlDocsTimer.restart();
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlDocsTimer
                interval: 350
                onTriggered: root.nlCollectDocs()
            }

            function nlCollectDocs() {
                const seen = {};
                const out = [];
                const term = nlPickerInput.text.trim().toLowerCase();
                const add = (id) => {
                    id = String(id);
                    if (seen[id] || id === root.nlDocId) return;
                    const e = Library.entryForId(id);
                    if (!e) return;
                    if (term !== "" && e.visibleName.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) < 0) return;
                    seen[id] = true;
                    out.push({ id: id, name: e.visibleName });
                };
                try {
                    if (root.nlLib && root.nlLib.entryIds) {
                        for (const id of root.nlLib.entryIds) add(id);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                }
                if (root.nlIndex) {
                    for (const id in root.nlIndex.docs) add(id);
                }
                root.nlPickerDocs = out.slice(0, 40);
            }

            function nlPickDoc(docId, name) {
                root.nlPickerDoc = docId;
                root.nlPickerDocName = name;
                root.nlPickerStage = "page";
                root.nlPickerPages = [];
                root.nlPickerNote = "";
                root.nlPickerLast = -1;
                nlPageInput.text = "";
                const entry = Library.entryForId(docId);
                root.nlPickerEntry = entry;
                let count = 0;
                if (docId === root.nlDocId) {
                    count = root.pageCount;
                    root.nlPickerLast = root.currentPage;
                } else if (entry) {
                    count = Number(entry.pageCount) || 0;
                    root.nlPickerLast = Number(entry.lastOpenedPage);
                    if (entry.archived) {
                        root.nlPickerNote = "This notebook isn't downloaded on the tablet. You can still link to the whole notebook.";
                    }
                }
                const makePages = (n, ids) => {
                    const pages = [];
                    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) pages.push({ i: i, id: ids && i < ids.length ? ids[i] : "" });
                    return pages;
                };
                if (docId === root.nlDocId) {
                    const ids = [];
                    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) ids.push(String(document.idForPage(i)));
                    root.nlPickerPages = makePages(count, ids);
                    nlPickerScroll.restart();
                    return;
                }
                if (count > 0) {
                    root.nlPickerPages = makePages(count, null);
                    nlPickerScroll.restart();
                }
                nlPickerGiveUp.restart();
                nlGet(nlRoot + docId + ".content", (text) => {
                    if (root.nlPickerDoc !== docId) return;
                    let ids = [];
                    try {
                        const c = JSON.parse(text);
                        if (c.cPages && c.cPages.pages) {
                            let live = c.cPages.pages.filter(p => !(p.deleted && p.deleted.value === 1));
                            live.sort((x, y) => {
                                const u = (x.idx && x.idx.value) || "";
                                const v = (y.idx && y.idx.value) || "";
                                return u < v ? -1 : (u > v ? 1 : 0);
                            });
                            ids = live.map(q => String(q.id));
                        } else if (Array.isArray(c.pages)) {
                            ids = c.pages.map(q => String(q));
                        }
                        if (count === 0 && ids.length === 0 && c.pageCount) count = Number(c.pageCount) || 0;
                    } catch (e) {
                        ids = [];
                    }
                    if (count === 0) count = ids.length;
                    if (count > 0) {
                        const first = root.nlPickerPages.length === 0;
                        root.nlPickerPages = makePages(count, ids);
                        if (first) nlPickerScroll.restart();
                    }
                });
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlPickerGiveUp
                interval: 3000
                onTriggered: {
                    if (root.nlPickerStage === "page" && root.nlPickerPages.length === 0 && root.nlPickerNote === "") {
                        root.nlPickerNote = "Couldn't read this notebook's pages. Link to the whole notebook, or type a page number above.";
                    }
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlPickerScroll
                interval: 150
                onTriggered: {
                    if (root.nlPickerLast > 0 && root.nlPickerLast < root.nlPickerPages.length) {
                        nlPageGrid.positionViewAtIndex(root.nlPickerLast, GridView.Center);
                    } else {
                        nlPageGrid.positionViewAtBeginning();
                    }
                }
            }

            function nlLinkToPageNumber(text) {
                const n = parseInt(String(text).trim(), 10);
                Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                if (isNaN(n) || n < 1) return;
                const pages = root.nlPickerPages;
                if (pages.length > 0 && n > pages.length) {
                    nlShowToast("This notebook has " + pages.length + " pages");
                    return;
                }
                const pg = pages.length >= n ? pages[n - 1] : { i: n - 1, id: "" };
                nlFinishLink(pg.id, pg.i);
            }

            function nlMakeThumb(holder, entry, pageIndex) {
                if (!entry || !holder) return null;
                try {
                    const t = Qt.createQmlObject(
                        "import QtQuick; import com.remarkable; import device.view.navigator; import device.ui.controls; " +
                        "PageThumbnail { anchors.fill: parent; asynchronous: true }",
                        holder, "noteLinksThumb");
                    t.document = entry;
                    t.documentId = entry.id;
                    t.page = pageIndex;
                    t.sourceSize = Qt.size(holder.width, holder.height);
                    return t;
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log("noteLinks: PageThumbnail unavailable " + e);
                    root.nlThumbsOff = true;
                    return null;
                }
            }

            function nlFinishLink(pageId, pageIndex) {
                const link = root.nlCapture;
                root.nlPickerOpen = false;
                if (!link || !root.nlData) return;
                link.targetDoc = root.nlPickerDoc;
                link.targetPage = pageId;
                link.targetPageNo = pageIndex + 1;
                link.targetName = root.nlPickerDocName;
                root.nlData.links.push(link);
                root.nlCapture = null;
                nlSave();
                nlShowToast("Linked to " + link.targetName + (pageIndex >= 0 ? " p." + (pageIndex + 1) : ""));
            }

            function nlGoTo(docId, pageId, pageHint, remember) {
                if (remember && document) {
                    root.nlBack = {
                        docId: root.nlDocId,
                        pageId: String(root.currentPageId),
                        page: root.currentPage,
                        name: document.visibleName
                    };
                }
                if (docId === root.nlDocId) {
                    let idx = pageId ? document.pageForId(pageId) : -1;
                    if ((typeof idx !== "number" || idx < 0) && pageHint > 0) idx = pageHint - 1;
                    if (typeof idx === "number" && idx >= 0 && idx < root.pageCount) {
                        root.openPage(idx);
                        root.nlBackShown = remember;
                        if (remember) nlBackTimer.restart();
                    } else if (pageId) {
                        nlShowToast("That page was deleted");
                    }
                    return;
                }
                const entry = Library.entryForId(docId);
                if (!entry) {
                    nlShowToast("The linked notebook was deleted");
                    return;
                }
                if (entry.archived) {
                    nlShowToast("Download \"" + entry.visibleName + "\" to this tablet first");
                    return;
                }
                root.nlPending = { docId: docId, pageId: pageId, hint: pageHint, back: remember };
                root.nlPanelOpen = false;
                navigator.requestOpenDocumentOnPage(entry, pageHint > 0 ? pageHint - 1 : 0);
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlPendingTimer
                interval: 300
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: {
                    root.nlPendingTicks++;
                    const p = root.nlPending;
                    if (!p || p.docId !== root.nlDocId || root.nlPendingTicks > 20) {
                        stop();
                        root.nlPending = null;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (root.pageCount <= 0) return;
                    if (p.pageId) {
                        const idx = document.pageForId(p.pageId);
                        if (typeof idx !== "number" || idx < 0) {
                            if (root.nlPendingTicks > 8) {
                                stop();
                                root.nlPending = null;
                                root.nlShowToast("That page was deleted");
                            }
                            return;
                        }
                        if (idx !== root.currentPage) root.openPage(idx);
                    }
                    stop();
                    root.nlPending = null;
                    root.nlBackShown = p.back;
                    if (p.back) nlBackTimer.restart();
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: nlBackTimer
                interval: 30000
                onTriggered: root.nlBackShown = false
            }

            function nlFollow(link) {
                nlGoTo(link.targetDoc, link.targetPage, link.targetPageNo, true);
            }

            function nlGoBack() {
                const b = root.nlBack;
                root.nlBackShown = false;
                root.nlBack = null;
                if (b) nlGoTo(b.docId, b.pageId, b.page + 1, false);
            }

            function nlRemove(entry) {
                root.nlMenuItem = null;
                if (!entry || !root.nlData) return;
                const item = entry.item;
                if (entry.kind === "link") {
                    root.nlData.links = root.nlData.links.filter(l => l.id !== item.id);
                } else {
                    root.nlData.tags = root.nlData.tags.filter(t => t.id !== item.id);
                    const stillThere = root.nlData.tags.some(t => t.pageId === item.pageId && t.tag === item.tag);
                    if (item.addedNative && !stillThere) {
                        const idx = document.pageForId(item.pageId);
                        if (typeof idx === "number" && idx >= 0) nlSetPageTag(idx, item.tag, false);
                    }
                }
                nlSave();
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: tags =================
            function nlCleanTag(s) {
                return String(s || "").replace(new RegExp("^#+"), "").replace(new RegExp("\\s+", "g"), " ").trim().substring(0, 40);
            }

            function nlAllTagLabels() {
                const set = {};
                try {
                    const labels = Library.tagLabels();
                    for (const t of labels) {
                        const name = typeof t === "string" ? t : (t.name || t.label || "");
                        if (name) set[name] = true;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                }
                if (root.nlIndex) {
                    for (const id in root.nlIndex.docs) {
                        for (const t of (root.nlIndex.docs[id].tags || [])) set[t.tag] = true;
                    }
                }
                return Object.keys(set).sort((a, b) => a.toLowerCase() < b.toLowerCase() ? -1 : 1);
            }

            function nlBeginTag() {
                const cap = nlTakeSelection();
                if (!cap) return;
                root.nlCapture = cap;
                root.nlTagSuggestion = "";
                root.nlTagTyped = false;
                nlTagInput.text = "";
                root.nlTagChoices = nlAllTagLabels();
                root.nlTagOpen = true;
                nlRecognize(cap.items, (text) => {
                    const words = text.split(" ");
                    const hashed = words.filter(w => w.charAt(0) === "#");
                    const t = nlCleanTag(hashed.length > 0 ? hashed[0] : words.slice(0, 3).join(" "));
                    root.nlTagSuggestion = t;
                    if (t !== "" && root.nlTagOpen && !root.nlTagTyped && nlTagInput.text === "") {
                        nlTagInput.text = t;
                    }
                });
            }

            function nlSetPageTag(pageIndex, tag, add) {
                try {
                    let current = [];
                    const existing = document.tagsForPage(pageIndex) || [];
                    for (const t of existing) current.push(typeof t === "string" ? t : (t.name || t.label || ""));
                    current = current.filter(t => t !== "");
                    const has = current.indexOf(tag) >= 0;
                    if (add && has) return false;
                    if (!add && !has) return false;
                    const next = add ? current.concat([tag]) : current.filter(t => t !== tag);
                    LibraryController.setPageTags(document.id, [pageIndex], next, []);
                    const map = root.pageTagMap;
                    const newTags = document.tagsForPage(pageIndex);
                    map[pageIndex] = newTags.length ? newTags : undefined;
                    root.pageTagMap = map;
                    if (pageIndex === root.currentPage) root.isTagged = newTags.length > 0;
                    return true;
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log("noteLinks: page tag failed " + e);
                    return false;
                }
            }

            function nlFinishTag(raw) {
                const tag = nlCleanTag(raw);
                const cap = root.nlCapture;
                root.nlTagOpen = false;
                Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                if (tag === "" || !cap || !root.nlData) return;
                let pageIndex = document.pageForId(cap.pageId);
                if (typeof pageIndex !== "number" || pageIndex < 0) pageIndex = cap.page;
                const added = nlSetPageTag(pageIndex, tag, true);
                root.nlData.tags.push({
                    id: nlNewId(),
                    pageId: cap.pageId,
                    pageNo: pageIndex + 1,
                    rect: cap.rect,
                    tag: tag,
                    addedNative: added
                });
                root.nlCapture = null;
                nlSave();
                nlShowToast("Tagged #" + tag);
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: panel data =================
            function nlTogglePanel() {
                root.nlMenuItem = null;
                if (root.nlPanelOpen) {
                    root.nlPanelOpen = false;
                    return;
                }
                nlLoadIndex(() => {
                    nlSyncIndex(false);
                    root.nlRev++;
                    root.nlPanelOpen = true;
                });
            }

            property var nlOutgoing: {
                root.nlRev;
                const out = [];
                if (!root.nlData) return out;
                const pid = String(root.currentPageId);
                for (const l of root.nlData.links) {
                    if (l.pageId === pid) out.push(l);
                }
                return out;
            }

            property var nlNotebookLinks: {
                root.nlRev;
                const out = [];
                if (!root.nlData) return out;
                const pid = String(root.currentPageId);
                for (const l of root.nlData.links) {
                    if (l.pageId !== pid) out.push(l);
                }
                out.sort((a, b) => root.nlPageNo(a.pageId) - root.nlPageNo(b.pageId));
                return out;
            }

            property var nlIncoming: {
                root.nlRev;
                const out = [];
                if (!root.nlIndex || root.nlDocId === "") return out;
                const pid = String(root.currentPageId);
                for (const id in root.nlIndex.docs) {
                    const d = root.nlIndex.docs[id];
                    for (const l of (d.links || [])) {
                        if (l.targetDoc !== root.nlDocId) continue;
                        if (l.targetPage && l.targetPage !== pid) continue;
                        out.push({ docId: id, docName: d.name, link: l });
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }

            property var nlTagIndex: {
                root.nlRev;
                const groups = {};
                if (!root.nlIndex) return [];
                for (const id in root.nlIndex.docs) {
                    const d = root.nlIndex.docs[id];
                    for (const t of (d.tags || [])) {
                        if (!groups[t.tag]) groups[t.tag] = [];
                        groups[t.tag].push({ docId: id, docName: d.name, tag: t });
                    }
                }
                return Object.keys(groups)
                    .sort((a, b) => a.toLowerCase() < b.toLowerCase() ? -1 : 1)
                    .map(k => ({ tag: k, hits: groups[k] }));
            }
            property var nlLinkSections: {
                root.nlRev;
                const here = root.nlDocId;
                const outRows = root.nlOutgoing.map(l => ({
                    title: root.nlDocName(l.targetDoc, l.targetName),
                    page: l.targetPageNo > 0 ? "p. " + l.targetPageNo : "whole notebook",
                    quote: l.label || "",
                    docId: l.targetDoc, pageId: l.targetPage, pageNo: l.targetPageNo
                }));
                const inRows = root.nlIncoming.map(x => ({
                    title: x.docId === here ? "This notebook" : (x.docName || "Notebook"),
                    page: x.link.pageNo > 0 ? "p. " + x.link.pageNo : "",
                    quote: x.link.label || "",
                    docId: x.docId, pageId: x.link.pageId, pageNo: x.link.pageNo
                }));
                const nbRows = root.nlNotebookLinks.map(l => ({
                    title: root.nlDocName(l.targetDoc, l.targetName),
                    page: "on p. " + root.nlPageNo(l.pageId),
                    quote: l.label || "",
                    docId: here, pageId: l.pageId, pageNo: root.nlPageNo(l.pageId)
                }));
                return [
                    { title: "FROM THIS PAGE", empty: "No links yet. Lasso some writing and tap Link.", rows: outRows },
                    { title: "LINKED FROM", empty: "Nothing links to this page yet.", rows: inRows },
                    { title: "ELSEWHERE IN THIS NOTEBOOK", empty: "No other links in this notebook.", rows: nbRows }
                ];
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: look =================
            readonly property string nlSerif: "EB Garamond"
            readonly property int nlHair: 2

            // ================= noteLinks: on-page layer =================
            Item {
                id: nlPageLayer
                parent: sceneView.uiOverlay
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 200
                visible: {
                    return Boolean(root.document) && root.nlPickerOpen === false && root.nlTagOpen === false;
                }

                // link badges and tag markers
                Repeater {
                    model: root.nlPageItems
                    delegate: Item {
                        id: nlBadge
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property bool isLink: modelData.kind === "link"
                        readonly property rect vr: {
                            if (sceneView.tileManager) sceneView.tileManager.sceneToViewTransform;
                            return root.nlToView(modelData.item.rect);
                        }
                        x: vr.x + vr.width + 14
                        y: vr.y + vr.height / 2 - height / 2
                        width: isLink ? 64 : nlTagText.implicitWidth + 44
                        height: 64

                        Rectangle {
                            visible: nlBadge.isLink
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            radius: 32
                            color: "black"
                            Canvas {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onPaint: {
                                    const c = getContext("2d");
                                    c.reset();
                                    c.strokeStyle = "white";
                                    c.lineWidth = 4;
                                    c.lineCap = "round";
                                    c.lineJoin = "round";
                                    c.beginPath();
                                    c.moveTo(22, 42);
                                    c.lineTo(42, 22);
                                    c.moveTo(27, 22);
                                    c.lineTo(42, 22);
                                    c.lineTo(42, 37);
                                    c.stroke();
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            visible: nlBadge.isLink === false
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.topMargin: 4
                            anchors.bottomMargin: 4
                            radius: height / 2
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: root.nlHair
                            Text {
                                id: nlTagText
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: "#" + (nlBadge.modelData.item.tag || "")
                                font.family: root.nlSerif
                                font.italic: true
                                font.pixelSize: 32
                                color: "black"
                            }
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: -12
                            onClicked: {
                                if (nlBadge.isLink) {
                                    root.nlFollow(nlBadge.modelData.item);
                                } else {
                                    root.nlOpenTag = nlBadge.modelData.item.tag;
                                    root.nlPanelTab = "tags";
                                    root.nlTogglePanel();
                                }
                            }
                            onPressAndHold: {
                                root.nlMenuItem = {
                                    entry: nlBadge.modelData,
                                    x: nlBadge.x,
                                    y: nlBadge.y + nlBadge.height + 12
                                };
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // lasso capsule: Link | Tag
                Rectangle {
                    id: nlChips
                    visible: {
                        return root.nlSelRect !== null && sceneView.itemSelectionMode;
                    }
                    readonly property rect sel: {
                        if (sceneView.tileManager) sceneView.tileManager.sceneToViewTransform;
                        return root.nlToView(root.nlSelRect);
                    }
                    width: 330
                    height: 84
                    radius: 42
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    x: {
                        const right = sel.x + sel.width + 48;
                        return right + width < nlPageLayer.width - 24 ? right : Math.max(24, sel.x - width - 48);
                    }
                    y: Math.max(24, Math.min(sel.y + sel.height / 2 - height / 2, nlPageLayer.height - height - 24))

                    Row {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        Item {
                            width: parent.width / 2
                            height: parent.height
                            Row {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                spacing: 12
                                Canvas {
                                    width: 30
                                    height: 30
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    onPaint: {
                                        const c = getContext("2d");
                                        c.reset();
                                        c.strokeStyle = "black";
                                        c.lineWidth = 3.5;
                                        c.lineCap = "round";
                                        c.lineJoin = "round";
                                        c.beginPath();
                                        c.moveTo(6, 24);
                                        c.lineTo(24, 6);
                                        c.moveTo(10, 6);
                                        c.lineTo(24, 6);
                                        c.lineTo(24, 20);
                                        c.stroke();
                                    }
                                }
                                Text {
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    text: "Link"
                                    font.family: root.nlSerif
                                    font.pixelSize: 38
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: root.nlBeginLink()
                            }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: root.nlHair
                            height: parent.height - 28
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        Item {
                            width: parent.width / 2 - root.nlHair
                            height: parent.height
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: "# Tag"
                                font.family: root.nlSerif
                                font.pixelSize: 38
                                color: "black"
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: root.nlBeginTag()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // long-press menu on a badge
                Rectangle {
                    visible: {
                        return root.nlMenuItem !== null;
                    }
                    x: root.nlMenuItem ? Math.min(root.nlMenuItem.x, nlPageLayer.width - width - 24) : 0
                    y: root.nlMenuItem ? root.nlMenuItem.y : 0
                    width: 340
                    height: nlMenuCol.height
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    radius: 16

                    Column {
                        id: nlMenuCol
                        width: parent.width
                        Repeater {
                            model: ["Remove", "Cancel"]
                            delegate: Item {
                                required property var modelData
                                required property int index
                                width: nlMenuCol.width
                                height: 92
                                Text {
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    x: 32
                                    text: {
                                        if (index === 1) return "Cancel";
                                        const e = root.nlMenuItem ? root.nlMenuItem.entry : null;
                                        return e && e.kind === "tag" ? "Remove tag" : "Remove link";
                                    }
                                    font.family: root.nlSerif
                                    font.pixelSize: 34
                                    font.italic: index === 1
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                                Rectangle {
                                    visible: index === 0
                                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                    x: 24
                                    width: parent.width - 48
                                    height: root.nlHair
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: {
                                        if (index === 0) {
                                            root.nlRemove(root.nlMenuItem ? root.nlMenuItem.entry : null);
                                        } else {
                                            root.nlMenuItem = null;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // ================= noteLinks: overlays (above toolbar) =================
            Item {
                id: nlOverlay
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 900

                // Back pill
                Rectangle {
                    visible: {
                        return root.nlBackShown && root.nlBack !== null;
                    }
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    y: 140
                    width: nlBackRow.width + 76
                    height: 80
                    radius: 40
                    color: "black"
                    Row {
                        id: nlBackRow
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        spacing: 16
                        Canvas {
                            width: 30
                            height: 30
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            onPaint: {
                                const c = getContext("2d");
                                c.reset();
                                c.strokeStyle = "white";
                                c.lineWidth = 3.5;
                                c.lineCap = "round";
                                c.lineJoin = "round";
                                c.beginPath();
                                c.moveTo(26, 15);
                                c.lineTo(5, 15);
                                c.moveTo(13, 6);
                                c.lineTo(4, 15);
                                c.lineTo(13, 24);
                                c.stroke();
                            }
                        }
                        Text {
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            text: root.nlBack ? "Back to " + root.nlBack.name + ", p. " + (root.nlBack.page + 1) : ""
                            color: "white"
                            font.family: root.nlSerif
                            font.pixelSize: 34
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            width: Math.min(implicitWidth, nlOverlay.width - 300)
                        }
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: -10
                        onClicked: root.nlGoBack()
                    }
                }

                // Toast
                Rectangle {
                    visible: {
                        return root.nlToast !== "";
                    }
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.bottomMargin: 180
                    width: nlToastText.implicitWidth + 80
                    height: 80
                    radius: 40
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    Text {
                        id: nlToastText
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: root.nlToast
                        color: "black"
                        font.family: root.nlSerif
                        font.italic: true
                        font.pixelSize: 34
                    }
                }

                // ---------- Link picker ----------
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    visible: root.nlPickerOpen
                    onClicked: {
                        root.nlPickerOpen = false;
                        root.nlCapture = null;
                        Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: nlPicker
                    visible: root.nlPickerOpen
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    y: 110
                    width: Math.min(parent.width - 120, 1160)
                    height: parent.height - 220 - (Qt.inputMethod.visible ? Qt.inputMethod.keyboardRectangle.height : 0)
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    radius: 20

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                    }

                    Item {
                        id: nlPickerHead
                        x: 56
                        y: 40
                        width: parent.width - 112
                        height: 112
                        Text {
                            id: nlPickerKicker
                            text: root.nlPickerStage === "doc" ? "LINK TO" : "CHOOSE A PAGE"
                            font.family: root.nlSerif
                            font.pixelSize: 22
                            font.letterSpacing: 6
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        Text {
                            anchors.top: nlPickerKicker.bottom
                            anchors.topMargin: 4
                            text: root.nlPickerStage === "doc" ? "Which notebook?" : root.nlPickerDocName
                            font.family: root.nlSerif
                            font.pixelSize: 56
                            color: "black"
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            width: parent.width - 200
                        }
                        Text {
                            anchors.right: parent.right
                            anchors.top: parent.top
                            anchors.topMargin: 20
                            text: root.nlPickerStage === "doc" ? "Cancel" : "Back"
                            font.family: root.nlSerif
                            font.italic: true
                            font.pixelSize: 34
                            color: "black"
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: -20
                                onClicked: {
                                    if (root.nlPickerStage === "doc") {
                                        root.nlPickerOpen = false;
                                        root.nlCapture = null;
                                        Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                                    } else {
                                        root.nlPickerStage = "doc";
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        id: nlPickerRule
                        anchors.top: nlPickerHead.bottom
                        anchors.topMargin: 16
                        x: 56
                        width: parent.width - 112
                        height: root.nlHair
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    // stage 1: notebooks
                    Item {
                        visible: root.nlPickerStage === "doc"
                        anchors.top: nlPickerRule.bottom
                        anchors.topMargin: 28
                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                        anchors.bottomMargin: 32
                        x: 56
                        width: parent.width - 112

                        Rectangle {
                            id: nlSearchBox
                            width: parent.width
                            height: 88
                            radius: 44
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: root.nlHair
                            color: "white"
                            Text {
                                visible: nlPickerInput.text === ""
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                x: 40
                                text: "Search notebooks"
                                color: "#555555"
                                font.family: root.nlSerif
                                font.italic: true
                                font.pixelSize: 34
                            }
                            GeneralTextInput {
                                id: nlPickerInput
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.leftMargin: 40
                                anchors.rightMargin: 40
                                verticalAlignment: TextInput.AlignVCenter
                                font.pixelSize: 32
                                color: "black"
                                selectedTextColor: "white"
                                selectionColor: "black"
                                inputMethodHints: Qt.ImhNoPredictiveText
                                onTextChanged: root.nlRefreshDocs(text)
                                onAccepted: Qt.inputMethod.hide()
                            }
                        }

                        Flickable {
                            anchors.top: nlSearchBox.bottom
                            anchors.topMargin: 20
                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            width: parent.width
                            clip: true
                            contentHeight: nlDocCol.height
                            boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

                            Column {
                                id: nlDocCol
                                width: parent.width
                                Repeater {
                                    model: {
                                        const here = root.document ? [{ id: root.nlDocId, name: root.document.visibleName, here: true }] : [];
                                        return here.concat(root.nlPickerDocs);
                                    }
                                    delegate: Item {
                                        required property var modelData
                                        required property int index
                                        width: nlDocCol.width
                                        height: 112
                                        Column {
                                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                            x: 4
                                            width: parent.width - 80
                                            Text {
                                                width: parent.width
                                                text: modelData.name
                                                font.family: root.nlSerif
                                                font.pixelSize: 40
                                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                                color: "black"
                                            }
                                            Text {
                                                visible: modelData.here === true
                                                text: "this notebook"
                                                font.family: root.nlSerif
                                                font.italic: true
                                                font.pixelSize: 28
                                                color: "black"
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Canvas {
                                            anchors.right: parent.right
                                            anchors.rightMargin: 8
                                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                            width: 22
                                            height: 36
                                            onPaint: {
                                                const c = getContext("2d");
                                                c.reset();
                                                c.strokeStyle = "black";
                                                c.lineWidth = 3;
                                                c.lineCap = "round";
                                                c.beginPath();
                                                c.moveTo(4, 4);
                                                c.lineTo(18, 18);
                                                c.lineTo(4, 32);
                                                c.stroke();
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Rectangle {
                                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                            width: parent.width
                                            height: 1
                                            color: "black"
                                        }
                                        MouseArea {
                                            anchors.fill: parent
                                            onClicked: {
                                                Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                                                root.nlPickDoc(modelData.id, modelData.name);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // stage 2: pages
                    Item {
