; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Home sidebar (hamburger menu): "Links graph" entry and a full-screen graph
; of every notebook linked with noteLinks. Reads the local index only.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT [[4911547370760691430]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // ================= noteLinks: graph =================
            Item {
                id: nlGraph
                parent: root.parent
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 900
                visible: false

                readonly property string nlIndexUrl: "file:///home/root/.local/share/notelinks/index.json"
                readonly property string nlSerif: "EB Garamond"
                property var nodes: []
                property var edges: []
                property bool showTags: true
                property var index: null
                property int selected: -1
                property string status: ""
                property int linkCount: 0
                property int tagCount: 0

                function openGraph() {
                    nlGraph.selected = -1;
                    nlGraph.status = "Reading links…";
                    nlGraph.nodes = [];
                    nlGraph.edges = [];
                    nlGraph.visible = true;
                    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
                        if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
                        let idx = null;
                        try {
                            idx = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                        } catch (e) {
                            idx = null;
                        }
                        nlGraph.index = (idx && idx.docs) ? idx : { v: 1, docs: {} };
                        nlGraph.build();
                    };
                    try {
                        xhr.open("GET", nlGraph.nlIndexUrl);
                        xhr.send();
                    } catch (e) {
                        nlGraph.index = { v: 1, docs: {} };
                        nlGraph.build();
                    }
                }

                function closeGraph() {
                    nlGraph.visible = false;
                    nlGraph.selected = -1;
                }

                function entryFor(docId) {
                    try {
                        return Library.entryForId(docId);
                    } catch (e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                }

                function docName(docId, fallback) {
                    const e = entryFor(docId);
                    if (e && e.visibleName) return String(e.visibleName);
                    return fallback || "Untitled";
                }

                function build() {
                    const docs = nlGraph.index.docs;
                    const nodes = [];
                    const byKey = ({});
                    const edgeMap = ({});
                    let links = 0;
                    let tags = 0;
                    const node = (key, kind, name, docId) => {
                        if (byKey[key] === undefined) {
                            byKey[key] = nodes.length;
                            nodes.push({ key: key, kind: kind, name: name, docId: docId, deg: 0, x: 0, y: 0, out: [], inn: [], spots: [] });
                        }
                        return byKey[key];
                    };
                    const edge = (a, b, kind) => {
                        if (a === b) return;
                        const k = a < b ? a + "-" + b : b + "-" + a;
                        if (!edgeMap[k]) edgeMap[k] = { a: a, b: b, w: 0, kind: kind };
                        edgeMap[k].w++;
                        nodes[a].deg++;
                        nodes[b].deg++;
                    };
                    for (const id in docs) {
                        const d = docs[id];
                        const hasAny = (d.links && d.links.length) || (nlGraph.showTags && d.tags && d.tags.length);
                        if (!hasAny) continue;
                        node("d:" + id, "doc", docName(id, d.name), id);
                    }
                    for (const id in docs) {
                        const d = docs[id];
                        for (const l of (d.links || [])) {
                            if (!l.targetDoc) continue;
                            links++;
                            const a = node("d:" + id, "doc", docName(id, d.name), id);
                            const b = node("d:" + l.targetDoc, "doc", docName(l.targetDoc, l.targetName), l.targetDoc);
                            nodes[a].out.push({ docId: l.targetDoc, pageNo: l.targetPageNo || 0, label: l.label || "", name: nodes[b].name });
                            nodes[b].inn.push({ docId: id, pageNo: l.pageNo || 0, label: l.label || "", name: nodes[a].name });
                            edge(a, b, "link");
                        }
                        if (!nlGraph.showTags) continue;
                        for (const t of (d.tags || [])) {
                            if (!t.tag) continue;
                            tags++;
                            const a = node("d:" + id, "doc", docName(id, d.name), id);
                            const b = node("t:" + t.tag, "tag", t.tag, "");
                            nodes[b].spots.push({ docId: id, pageNo: t.pageNo || 0, name: nodes[a].name });
                            edge(a, b, "tag");
                        }
                    }
                    const edges = Object.keys(edgeMap).map(k => edgeMap[k]);
                    nlGraph.layout(nodes, edges);
                    nlGraph.linkCount = links;
                    nlGraph.tagCount = tags;
                    nlGraph.edges = edges;
                    nlGraph.nodes = nodes;
                    nlGraph.status = nodes.length === 0 ? "No links yet. In a notebook, lasso some writing and tap Link." : "";
                    nlEdges.requestPaint();
                }

                // Deterministic force layout (Fruchterman-Reingold), fitted to the canvas.
                function layout(nodes, edges) {
                    const n = nodes.length;
                    if (n === 0) return;
                    const W = 1000;
                    const H = 1000;
                    const k = Math.sqrt((W * H) / n) * 0.75;
                    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        const a = (2 * Math.PI * i) / n;
                        const r = 300 + 40 * (i % 3);
                        nodes[i].x = W / 2 + r * Math.cos(a);
                        nodes[i].y = H / 2 + r * Math.sin(a);
                    }
                    let temp = W / 8;
                    for (let it = 0; it < 300; it++) {
                        const dx = new Array(n).fill(0);
                        const dy = new Array(n).fill(0);
                        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            for (let j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                                let vx = nodes[i].x - nodes[j].x;
                                let vy = nodes[i].y - nodes[j].y;
                                let d = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
                                if (d < 0.01) {
                                    vx = 0.01 * (i + 1);
                                    vy = 0.01 * (j + 1);
                                    d = 0.02;
                                }
                                const f = (k * k) / d;
                                dx[i] += (vx / d) * f;
                                dy[i] += (vy / d) * f;
                                dx[j] -= (vx / d) * f;
                                dy[j] -= (vy / d) * f;
                            }
                        }
                        for (const e of edges) {
                            const vx = nodes[e.a].x - nodes[e.b].x;
                            const vy = nodes[e.a].y - nodes[e.b].y;
                            const d = Math.max(0.01, Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy));
                            const f = (d * d) / k * (e.kind === "tag" ? 0.6 : 1);
                            dx[e.a] -= (vx / d) * f;
                            dy[e.a] -= (vy / d) * f;
                            dx[e.b] += (vx / d) * f;
                            dy[e.b] += (vy / d) * f;
                        }
                        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            dx[i] += (W / 2 - nodes[i].x) * 0.02 * k / 10;
                            dy[i] += (H / 2 - nodes[i].y) * 0.02 * k / 10;
                            const d = Math.max(0.01, Math.sqrt(dx[i] * dx[i] + dy[i] * dy[i]));
                            nodes[i].x += (dx[i] / d) * Math.min(d, temp);
                            nodes[i].y += (dy[i] / d) * Math.min(d, temp);
                        }
                        temp = Math.max(1, temp * 0.985);
                    }
                    let minX = 1e9, minY = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, maxY = -1e9;
                    for (const p of nodes) {
                        minX = Math.min(minX, p.x);
                        minY = Math.min(minY, p.y);
                        maxX = Math.max(maxX, p.x);
                        maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.y);
                    }
                    const spanX = Math.max(1, maxX - minX);
                    const spanY = Math.max(1, maxY - minY);
                    for (const p of nodes) {
                        p.x = n === 1 ? 0.5 : (p.x - minX) / spanX;
                        p.y = n === 1 ? 0.5 : (p.y - minY) / spanY;
                    }
                }

                function isNeighbour(i) {
                    const s = nlGraph.selected;
                    if (s < 0 || i === s) return true;
                    for (const e of nlGraph.edges) {
                        if ((e.a === s && e.b === i) || (e.b === s && e.a === i)) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                function openDoc(docId, pageNo) {
                    const e = entryFor(docId);
                    if (!e) {
                        nlGraph.status = "That notebook was deleted.";
                        return;
                    }
                    if (e.archived) {
                        nlGraph.status = "Download “" + e.visibleName + "” to this tablet first.";
                        return;
                    }
                    nlGraph.closeGraph();
                    const args = ({});
                    args.documentId = docId;
                    args.openedFrom = "noteLinks graph";
                    if (pageNo > 0) args.page = pageNo - 1;
                    root.windowNavigator.open("legacydevice/window/main", args);
                }

                function cardRows() {
                    const s = nlGraph.selected;
                    if (s < 0 || s >= nlGraph.nodes.length) return [];
                    const n = nlGraph.nodes[s];
                    const rows = [];
                    if (n.kind === "tag") {
                        for (const x of n.spots) rows.push({ arrow: "#", name: x.name, page: x.pageNo, label: "", docId: x.docId });
                        return rows;
                    }
                    for (const x of n.out) rows.push({ arrow: "→", name: x.name, page: x.pageNo, label: x.label, docId: x.docId });
                    for (const x of n.inn) rows.push({ arrow: "←", name: x.name, page: x.pageNo, label: x.label, docId: x.docId });
                    return rows;
                }

                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onClicked: nlGraph.selected = -1
                }

                Rectangle {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    color: "white"
                }

                // ---- header ----
                Item {
                    id: nlGraphHead
                    anchors.top: parent.top
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.margins: 72
                    height: 220

                    Text {
                        id: nlGraphKicker
                        text: "NOTELINKS"
                        font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        font.letterSpacing: 8
                        color: "black"
                    }
                    Text {
                        id: nlGraphTitle
                        anchors.top: nlGraphKicker.bottom
                        anchors.topMargin: 8
                        text: "Links graph"
                        font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                        font.pixelSize: 76
                        color: "black"
                    }
                    Text {
                        anchors.top: nlGraphTitle.bottom
                        anchors.topMargin: 4
                        text: {
                            const n = nlGraph.nodes.filter(x => x.kind === "doc").length;
                            let s = n + (n === 1 ? " notebook · " : " notebooks · ") + nlGraph.linkCount + (nlGraph.linkCount === 1 ? " link" : " links");
                            if (nlGraph.showTags) s += " · " + nlGraph.tagCount + (nlGraph.tagCount === 1 ? " tag spot" : " tag spots");
                            return s;
                        }
                        font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                        font.italic: true
                        font.pixelSize: 32
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    Row {
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.top: parent.top
                        spacing: 20
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 190
                            height: 76
                            radius: 38
                            color: nlGraph.showTags ? "black" : "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: 3
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: "# Tags"
                                font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                font.pixelSize: 32
                                color: nlGraph.showTags ? "white" : "black"
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    nlGraph.showTags = !nlGraph.showTags;
                                    nlGraph.selected = -1;
                                    nlGraph.build();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 170
                            height: 76
                            radius: 38
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: 3
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: "Close"
                                font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                font.italic: true
                                font.pixelSize: 32
                                color: "black"
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: nlGraph.closeGraph()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                        width: parent.width
                        height: 2
                        color: "black"
                    }
                }

                Text {
                    visible: nlGraph.status.length > 0
                    anchors.top: nlGraphHead.bottom
                    anchors.topMargin: 40
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.leftMargin: 72
                    anchors.rightMargin: 72
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: nlGraph.status
                    font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                    font.italic: true
                    font.pixelSize: 36
                    color: "black"
                    z: 5
                }

                // ---- graph area ----
                Item {
                    id: nlGraphArea
                    anchors.top: nlGraphHead.bottom
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.leftMargin: 200
                    anchors.rightMargin: 200
                    anchors.topMargin: 150
                    anchors.bottomMargin: nlGraph.selected >= 0 ? 830 : 200

                    function px(i) {
                        return nlGraph.nodes[i].x * width;
                    }
                    function py(i) {
                        return nlGraph.nodes[i].y * height;
                    }
                    onWidthChanged: nlEdges.requestPaint()
                    onHeightChanged: nlEdges.requestPaint()

                    Canvas {
                        id: nlEdges
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: -200
                        onPaint: {
                            const c = getContext("2d");
                            c.reset();
                            c.translate(200, 200);
                            const s = nlGraph.selected;
                            for (const e of nlGraph.edges) {
                                if (e.a >= nlGraph.nodes.length || e.b >= nlGraph.nodes.length) continue;
                                const hot = s >= 0 && (e.a === s || e.b === s);
                                const dim = s >= 0 && !hot;
                                c.strokeStyle = dim ? "#555555" : "black";
                                c.lineWidth = e.kind === "tag" ? (hot ? 3 : 1.5) : Math.min(8, (hot ? 4 : 2.5) + e.w);
                                if (e.kind === "tag") c.setLineDash([6, 8]);
                                else c.setLineDash([]);
                                c.beginPath();
                                c.moveTo(nlGraphArea.px(e.a), nlGraphArea.py(e.a));
                                c.lineTo(nlGraphArea.px(e.b), nlGraphArea.py(e.b));
                                c.stroke();
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Repeater {
                        model: nlGraph.nodes
                        delegate: Item {
                            id: nlNode
                            required property var modelData
                            required property int index
                            readonly property bool isDoc: modelData.kind === "doc"
                            readonly property bool isSel: nlGraph.selected === index
                            readonly property bool near: nlGraph.isNeighbour(index)
                            readonly property real dot: isDoc ? Math.min(64, 30 + modelData.deg * 6) : 22
                            x: modelData.x * nlGraphArea.width - width / 2
                            y: modelData.y * nlGraphArea.height - dot / 2
                            width: Math.max(dot, nlNodeLabel.width) + 24
                            height: dot + nlNodeLabel.height + 12
                            z: isSel ? 3 : 1

                            Rectangle {
                                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                                width: nlNode.dot
                                height: nlNode.dot
                                radius: nlNode.dot / 2
                                color: {
                                    if (nlNode.isSel) return "white";
                                    if (nlNode.isDoc === false) return "white";
                                    return nlNode.near ? "black" : "#555555";
                                }
                                border.color: nlNode.near ? "black" : "#555555"
                                border.width: nlNode.isSel ? 8 : 3
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                anchors.fill: nlNodeLabel
                                anchors.margins: -6
                                color: "white"
                                radius: 8
                            }
                            Text {
                                id: nlNodeLabel
                                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                                y: nlNode.dot + 6
                                width: Math.min(implicitWidth, 380)
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                                text: nlNode.isDoc ? nlNode.modelData.name : "#" + nlNode.modelData.name
                                font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                font.italic: nlNode.isDoc === false
                                font.pixelSize: nlNode.isDoc ? 36 : 30
                                font.bold: nlNode.isSel
                                color: nlNode.near ? "black" : "#555555"
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: -16
                                onClicked: {
                                    nlGraph.selected = nlNode.isSel ? -1 : nlNode.index;
                                    nlEdges.requestPaint();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // ---- selection card ----
                Rectangle {
                    id: nlGraphCard
                    visible: nlGraph.selected >= 0 && nlGraph.selected < nlGraph.nodes.length
                    readonly property var node: visible ? nlGraph.nodes[nlGraph.selected] : null
                    readonly property var rows: visible ? nlGraph.cardRows() : []
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.margins: 48
                    height: 680
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    radius: 24

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                    }

                    Text {
                        id: nlCardKicker
                        x: 48
                        y: 40
                        text: { return (nlGraphCard.node && nlGraphCard.node.kind === "tag") ? "TAG · " + nlGraphCard.rows.length + " SPOTS" : "NOTEBOOK"; }
                        font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                        font.pixelSize: 22
                        font.letterSpacing: 6
                        color: "black"
                    }
                    Text {
                        id: nlCardTitle
                        x: 48
                        anchors.top: nlCardKicker.bottom
                        anchors.topMargin: 6
                        width: parent.width - 96 - nlCardOpen.width
                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                        text: nlGraphCard.node ? (nlGraphCard.node.kind === "tag" ? "#" + nlGraphCard.node.name : nlGraphCard.node.name) : ""
                        font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                        font.italic: nlGraphCard.node ? nlGraphCard.node.kind === "tag" : false
                        font.pixelSize: 56
                        color: "black"
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        id: nlCardOpen
                        visible: nlGraphCard.node ? nlGraphCard.node.kind === "doc" : false
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.rightMargin: 48
                        y: 48
                        width: 300
                        height: 80
                        radius: 40
                        color: "black"
                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Open notebook"

                            font.pixelSize: 32
                            color: "white"
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: nlGraph.openDoc(nlGraphCard.node.docId, 0)
                        }
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        id: nlCardRule
                        x: 48
                        anchors.top: nlCardTitle.bottom
                        anchors.topMargin: 16
                        width: parent.width - 96
                        height: 2
                        color: "black"
                    }
                    ListView {
                        anchors.top: nlCardRule.bottom
                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                        anchors.bottomMargin: 24
                        x: 48
                        width: parent.width - 96
                        clip: true
                        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                        model: nlGraphCard.rows
                        delegate: Item {
                            required property var modelData
                            width: ListView.view.width
                            height: 96
                            Text {
                                id: nlRowArrow
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                width: 56
                                text: modelData.arrow
                                font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                font.pixelSize: 40
                                color: "black"
                            }
                            Column {
                                anchors.left: nlRowArrow.right
                                anchors.right: nlRowGo.left
                                anchors.rightMargin: 16
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                Text {
                                    width: parent.width
                                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                                    text: modelData.name + (modelData.page > 0 ? ", p. " + modelData.page : "")
                                    font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                    font.pixelSize: 36
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                                Text {
                                    visible: modelData.label.length > 0
                                    width: parent.width
                                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                                    text: "“" + modelData.label + "”"
                                    font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                    font.italic: true
                                    font.pixelSize: 28
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                            }
                            Text {
                                id: nlRowGo
                                anchors.right: parent.right
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                text: "Open"
                                font.family: nlGraph.nlSerif
                                font.italic: true
                                font.pixelSize: 32
                                font.underline: true

                            Rectangle {

                                color: "black"

                }
            }
        }
